inputs.text: Families need dependable homes, not government spin about lease figures. Micheál Martin may point to more tenancies, but that means little when people still face emergency accommodation or fear eviction. Forcing landlords into six-year leases from March 1 risks driving ordinary providers away and shrinking choices for renters. A housing policy that makes it harder to provide homes is no help to families; government should put stability and responsibility ahead of headline numbers and more rules.
